'''''Aloina''''' is a genus of [[mosses]] belonging to the family [[Pottiaceae]]<ref name="worldfloraonline.org">{{cite web |title=Aloina Kindb. |url=http://www.worldfloraonline.org/taxon/wfo-4000001343 |website=www.worldfloraonline.org |access-date=10 February 2021}}</ref> first described by [[Nils Conrad Kindberg]].<ref name="worldfloraonline.org" /> It has a [[cosmopolitan distribution]].<ref name="GBIF">{{cite web |title=Aloina Kindb. |url=https://www.gbif.org/species/2671379 |website=www.gbif.org |access-date=10 February 2021 |language=en}}</ref>

==Species== 
The following species are recognised in the genus ''Aloina'':<ref name="worldfloraonline.org" />
* ''[[Aloina aloides]]'' <small>(Koch ex Schultz) Kindb.</small>
* ''[[Aloina ambigua]]'' <small>(Bruch & Schimp.) Limpr.</small>
* ''[[Aloina apiculata]]'' <small>(E.B. Bartram) Delgad.</small>
* ''[[Aloina bifrons]]'' <small>(De Not.) Delgad.</small>
* ''[[Aloina brevirostris]]'' <small>(Hook. & Grev.) Kindb.</small>
* ''[[Aloina calceolifolia]]'' <small>(Spruce ex Mitt.) Broth.</small>
* ''[[Aloina catillum]]'' <small>(Müll. Hal.) Broth.</small>
* ''[[Aloina cornifolia]]'' <small>Delgad.</small>
* ''[[Aloina hamulus]]'' <small>(Müll. Hal.) Broth.</small>
* ''[[Aloina humilis]]'' <small>M. T. Gallego, Cano & Ros</small>
* ''[[Aloina macrorrhyncha]]'' <small>(Kindb.) Kindb.</small>
* ''[[Aloina recurvipatula]]'' <small>(Müll. Hal.) Broth.</small>
* ''[[Aloina rigida]]'' <small>(Hedw.) Limpr.</small>
* ''[[Aloina roseae]]'' <small>(R.S. Williams) Delgad.</small>
* ''[[Aloina sedifolia]]'' <small>(Müll. Hal.) Broth.</small>
* ''[[Aloina sullivaniana]]''<small>(Müll. Hal.) Broth.</small>
